description: This file is a database migration script using Alembic for the Apache Superset project. It defines schema changes to assign creator owners to slices and dashboards, including ORM classes and an upgrade function.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Declarative ORM class representing users in the database.

classes.name: AuditMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing created_by foreign key and relationship for audit purposes.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: ORM class representing slices, with owner relationships.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: ORM class representing dashboards, with owner relationships.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the migration: assigns creator as owner to slices and dashboards if not already set.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Placeholder for downgrade logic, currently does nothing.
